criterion: Creates a plan document under docs/plans/ (active or completed/) detailing the OrderStore outbox staging and OutboxRelay.flush_pending workflow.
Stages an OutboxRecord whenever OrderStore.create_order succeeds (and stages nothing if order validation fails) in outboxrelay/engine.py.
Implements OutboxRelay.flush_pending(publisher) to deliver unsent outbox records in creation order, marking delivered records sent and tracking retry attempts on transient publisher exceptions.
Adds unit tests under tests/ covering atomic staging, partial failure mid-flush, subsequent retry completion without re-sending already delivered records, and ordering.
All unit tests under tests/ pass when run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
